about: The handle set each side of the cutover serves at its MCP door, and the old stack's authorization server, which its protected-resource document names: by it the platform's canary (platform/deploy/canary.ts) knows the platform dark, the doors' own document naming their origin instead. The doors' set is the one it checks live, and each old-only handle it holds absent.

old.why: The old stack's live surface (PR-178 and the 2026-07-24 canonical convergence), as recorded: scripts/mcp_public_canary.py --assert-handles holds tools/list to exactly its own literal CANONICAL_HANDLES, which tests/test_handles_canary.py holds this list to. It leaves at the cutover's hold's end (platform/cutover.json).

new.why: The doors' tools for a custom connector: platform/doors/profiles.json's custom profile, what every MCP grant and API key is served until the owner narrows it, which is the doors' whole tool table (platform/doors/src/tools.ts). platform/doors/guards/handles.test.ts holds this list to both.
